config_name: ROG Zephyrus G16 (2025) — Core Ultra 9 285H / RTX 5070 8GB, 32GB LPDDR5X, 1TB SSD, 16" 2.5K OLED 240Hz

specs.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Laptop 8GB (TGP-capped slim chassis ~105-110W)
specs.keyboard_notes: backlit chiclet, per-key RGB; NBC: 'brilliant input devices'

battery.notes: 90Wh. NBC lab WiFi test on GU605CX: 9h00 @150nits / 6h43 max brightness; ~5-7h real mixed use, ~1.5h gaming. USB-C PD charging.

price.notes: BBY API 2026-11-24, sku 19338500, regularPrice $3,699.95 (no sale). BBY customer rating 4.67/5, n=320 — highest-volume G16 listing, user anchor for the line.

offers.name: ASUS Zephyrus G16 16" 240Hz OLED Gaming Laptop - Intel Core Ultra 9 285H - 32GB LPDDR5X - 1TB SSD - NVIDIA RTX 5070 - Windows 11 Home - Eclipse Grey

reviews.quote: The ROG Zephyrus G16's 2025 update offers several upgrades... it's still important to know that it uses a relatively slow version of the GPU. Other improvements include Wi-Fi 7, 64 GB of RAM, and longer battery life. The input devices and speakers remain very good. (NBC 'very good' 90%, tested GU605CX RTX 5090 config; cons: GPU unable to reach its potential, soldered RAM, limited maximum HDR brightness, PWM flickering.)

professional.note: CA user anchor config (BBY 4.67/5, n=320). Pro anchor is NBC's line-level 90% on the RTX 5090 tier; GPU-tier delta applied here.

praises: Best Buy crowd favourite of the line (4.67/5 across 320 reviews): the 5070 + OLED combo is repeatedly called the sweet spot
2.5K OLED 240Hz with G-Sync drives 2.5K gaming smoothly with DLSS — inky blacks and vivid HDR-ish SDR pop
Premium aluminum at ~1.85 kg: buyers pick it as a work-by-day / games-by-night machine that doesn't look like a gaming laptop
NBC-praised speakers and keyboard/trackpad are best-in-class for gaming machines
~6-8h real battery on the 90Wh cell plus USB-C charging — you can leave the brick home on work days
complaints: 8GB VRAM on the 5070 is the recurring worry: newest AAA titles at 2.5K need DLSS and texture drops
Slim-chassis TGP cap means the 5070 trails thicker same-GPU laptops (Legion/Strix) by ~5-10% sustained FPS
Soldered RAM — 32GB is the ceiling forever
PWM flickering on the OLED and limited HDR peak brightness (both NBC cons) bother some owners
Lid creak / hinge rocking plus a fan that pulses audibly at idle; also full $3,700 with frequent sales just below

design_philosophy: The volume sweet spot of ASUS's halo slim 16-inch line: same aluminum OLED chassis as the flagship, with the mid RTX 5070 that best matches the 2.5K panel without the flagship's price. It embodies the line's trade — portable premium design and class-leading display over maximum GPU wattage.
rating_notes: Inferred from NBC GU605CX (285H/5090/64GB) 90% anchor per SHARED-zephyrus-g16.md: -2.5 gaming for 5070 tier (still TGP-capped; 8GB VRAM caps ai_ml/creative vs higher tiers), +0.4 battery and +0.4 thermals_noise vs 5090 anchor. Battery = NBC lab 9h WiFi minus user calibration (~6.5 real). Upgradability 3.0 (soldered RAM, 2x M.2). User pool warmer than pros on value (4.67/5).
